# fluss-go v0.1.0-beta.7

This prerelease hardens the public API, security, failure-recovery, and remote
storage verification needed for broader Apache Fluss 0.9.1 beta testing.

## Highlights

- Splits the S3, OSS, HDFS, and OpenTelemetry adapters into independently
  versioned Go modules so core-only consumers do not inherit optional SDKs.
- Adds reviewed API baselines and a required compatibility gate for `fmsg`,
  `fgo`, `fadm`, and every optional adapter module.
- Adds a fail-closed dependency-license policy and canary alongside the
  existing vulnerability, misconfiguration, and secret scans.
- Expands live Fluss 0.9.1 coverage for failure recovery, TLS termination,
  SASL PLAIN, advanced administration, reliability profiles, and cancellation.
- Adds reproducible MinIO and Apache Hadoop service tests for S3 and HDFS,
  plus an opt-in read-only managed Alibaba Cloud OSS workflow.
- Records the Fluss 0.9.1 lake snapshot contract and the evidence-based
  decision to defer native Iceberg, Lance, and Paimon readers.

## Upgrade notes

- Applications that use an optional adapter must select its module explicitly,
  for example `go get github.com/pletorco/fluss-go/adapters/s3@v0.1.0-beta.7`.
  The root module and all four adapters are published at the same beta version.
- Root-only applications retain the existing `fmsg`, `fgo`, and `fadm` import
  paths and no longer acquire optional storage or observability SDK graphs.
- The HDFS adapter remains an application-owned client boundary; it does not
  select an HDFS protocol implementation or own Kerberos credentials.
- Lake snapshot administration is supported, but beta.7 does not claim native
  Iceberg, Lance, or Paimon data-file reading.
- Use Go 1.25.12 or newer in the 1.25 series, or Go 1.26.5 or newer in the 1.26
  series.

See the [full changelog](../../CHANGELOG.md), the
[module-layout guide](../../docs/module-layout.md), the
[remote-storage guide](../../docs/remote-storage.md), the
[reliability guide](../../docs/reliability-testing.md), and the
[lake-format decision](../../docs/lake-formats.md).

This is a pre-v1 release. Pin the root and adapter module versions and review
the changelog before upgrading.
